product.title: Private 45 Minute Helicopter Tour with Romantic Landing

description.text: A private helicopter flight over Oahu passes lush valleys, Diamond Head crater, and the South Shore. The flight lands at a private oasis away from crowds, where leis, chocolates, and champagne are waiting. The helicopter is reserved for the booking, and several departure times are offered from Honolulu. Leis, chocolates, and champagne are set out at that private Oahu landing after the pass over the crater, the valleys, and the South Shore. Several departure times are offered so the private Honolulu flight can be scheduled for the party.
